implemented.scope: Whole JOINTPOS to/from POSITION/XYZWPR/XYZWPREXT assignments, individual fields/elements and function-result RHS values
implemented.context: Calling root task group, selected configured frame/tool and existing supplied forward/inverse adapters or standard-DH model
